name: Yuktravel
description: An Indonesian travel agency running a dedicated "Yuktravel Active" sports-travel arm, an official International Tour Operator for the Gold Coast Marathon for over a decade and a stated supporter of Abbott World Marathon Majors travel including Sydney, Chicago, and New York.

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Yuk Travel" under Indonesia on London Marathon Events' own official tour operators page.

editorial_notes: Verified directly against London Marathon Events' own official tour-operator listing (as "Yuk Travel") on 2026-08-11. The agency's own site additionally describes a decade-long official ITO relationship with the Gold Coast Marathon and support for Sydney/Chicago/New York Abbott World Marathon Majors travel, which we have not independently verified against each of those races' own organizer pages.
